text: No, the JRC map does not show the 2023 loss. The JRC dataset (GFC2020) is static and only provides forest cover data for the year 2020. It shows that the entire event area was mapped as forest in 2020, but it does not include observations beyond that year. The tree-cover loss in 2023 was detected by the Hansen GFC dataset, which operates on an annual basis. The JRC map serves as a reference point for corroborating the event area in 2020 but does not reflect changes occurring after that date.
